rule: Selected by action order, main gyro axis, stable boundaries and return behavior; never by closeness to a desired result.
excluded_from_axis_examples: Dynamic source 0–20s already starts in motion and contains earlier mixed operations; retained in the full original.
transport_rule: Only full-session END may be used for packet-loss denominator. Selected files have end=null; source_end is audit context only.
video: Operator confirms video is held on another device; attach the original video separately for final submission.

selections.name: axis_x
selections.reason: Second-round X-dominant raise-and-return; retains cross-axis human motion.

selections.name: axis_y
selections.reason: Second-round Y-dominant raise-and-return; about 59.5% Y gyro energy, visibly mixed-axis.

selections.name: axis_z
selections.reason: Second-round Z-dominant turn-and-return; interpret with operator observation/video.

selections.name: continuous_pose
selections.reason: 43.75-second multi-axis follow display; includes pauses and axis tests, not 43.75 seconds of uninterrupted nonzero rotation.

selections.name: short_rest
selections.reason: Only 4.16 seconds of final rest; cannot replace the prescribed 60/300-second static tests.

selections.name: displacement_attempt
selections.reason: Rest-to-rest translation attempt with relatively stable attitude; about 0.58m estimated change, not evidence of accurate 15cm displacement.
